decision: Continue qualified follow-on source admission independently. Its CLI additions do not alter the A1 derive/cache implementation or eager selected-store transport; performance effects were not measured. A28 remains a concrete programme acceptance gate, and follow-on landing is not a performance pass.

smallest_useful_correction.scope: Separate bounded T4 prewarm implementation in scripts/build_output_health.py:_prewarm_head_contents, retaining existing read semantics and canonical owner.
smallest_useful_correction.change: Replace capture_output of whole git cat-file batch with an incrementally parsed, immutable-revision-bound stream. Inspect header type/size before retaining any body, bound each read and body retention using the existing cap, preserve missing/empty/nonUTF8/source reason semantics and stream cleanup. No entire stdout buffer before cap.
smallest_useful_correction.why_bounded: This removes a demonstrated contract violation in one source optimization without changing which claims/grades/rows count or the selected legacy/native owner. It is not by itself a complete A28 fix: the existing oversize fallback and cache retention remain explicit obligations.
smallest_useful_correction.acceptance: Use existing framing/empty/newline/cache parity controls plus adversarial oversized/truncated stream and process cleanup cases against the same complete-result contract. Do not add another broad benchmark, reload production corpus or claim measured savings from old small fixtures.

subsequent_T1_obligation.observed_contract: _load_qledger obtains complete claims text and splits it; legacy worktree/git readers have no byte/time cap. Existing open_raw_lines already provides incremental selected-binding transport, so assess adapting the consumer through that existing interface, not a new claims store or owner.
subsequent_T1_obligation.preserve: Current ClaimsReadScope, complete counts/horizon/unknown/owner semantics, verified native snapshot and legacy/git fallback provenance, generation refusal and typed inability. No truncating firstNrows/claims, forced owner/cutover, source clock reset, or altered QLedger producer.
